title: Bridged Ethernet
markdown:
- **(a) Without bridging**: 12 stations (two visual clusters of 6) all
  sit on one continuous bus line — one single network.
- **(b) With bridging**: the same 12 stations are split into two
  6-station bus segments, joined in the middle by a **Bridge** device.

{{viz:0}}

- **(a) Without bridging**: all 12 stations sit inside **one** large
  collision domain spanning the whole bus.
- **(b) With bridging**: the bridge divides the network into multiple
  isolated collision domains.

{{viz:1}}
